discussion_comments.comment_body: Considered this. The tool only ever writes `.env` as UTF-8 (`setup_wizard.py` uses `encoding='utf-8'`), so UTF-8 is the correct read contract — the old locale-based read was the actual bug, not a feature. A hand-written cp1252 `.env` with smart quotes was already fragile: it would decode differently depending on the user's locale, which is exactly the non-determinism this PR removes. If we want to be defensive about legacy files later, the right move is an explicit fallback (lenient decode + warning), not an implicit locale codec. Keeping the loader strict and predictable. Resolving.
